theory.intro: A flow network can be given as a table instead of a diagram. Each row is the vertex an edge starts **from**, each column is the vertex it goes **to**, and the entry is that edge's capacity.
facts: An entry in row $A$, column $B$ gives the capacity of the directed edge from $A$ to $B$.
A dash or a blank entry means there is no edge in that direction.
The table of a flow network is **not symmetric**, because each edge may be travelled one way only.
The **source** is the vertex whose column is entirely dashes, since no edge is directed into it.
The **sink** is the vertex whose row is entirely dashes, since no edge is directed out of it.
Only the edges, their directions and their capacities matter; where a vertex sits on the page does not.
Draw every edge with a mid-line arrowhead so its direction is clear at a glance.
steps: Identify the source and the sink from the table
Draw and label a vertex for each row and column heading
Draw a directed edge for every entry that is not a dash
Write each edge's capacity beside it

foundation.question_text:
The table gives the capacities of the one-way links in a network.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & T \\ \hline S & - & 12 & 9 & - & - \\ A & - & - & 5 & 8 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 14 \\ C & - & - & - & - & 7 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

A flow network is recorded in this table.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & P & Q & R & U & V \\ \hline P & - & - & - & 6 & - \\ Q & 9 & - & 11 & - & - \\ R & - & - & - & 7 & - \\ U & - & - & - & - & 13 \\ V & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Which vertex is the source and which is the sink?
Explain how the table shows this.
foundation.solution_text:
1. **Identify the source and the sink from the table**
Column $Q$ contains only dashes, so no edge is directed into $Q$.
Row $V$ contains only dashes, so no edge is directed out of $V$.
$Q$ is the source and $V$ is the sink.

Each edge is recorded once, in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & T \\ \hline S & - & 11 & 16 & - & - \\ A & - & - & 6 & 8 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 19 \\ C & - & - & - & - & 13 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$

foundation.question_text:
A water utility pumps water from a bore $S$ to a town $T$ through pumping stations $A$, $B$ and $C$.
Every pipe carries water in one direction only.
Water can be pumped from $S$ to $A$ at up to $40$ kL/h, from $S$ to $B$ at up to $35$ kL/h, from $A$ to $C$ at up to $25$ kL/h, from $B$ to $C$ at up to $20$ kL/h, from $B$ to $T$ at up to $18$ kL/h, and from $C$ to $T$ at up to $38$ kL/h.
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

The table gives the capacities of the one-way links in a network with six vertices.
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & D & T \\ \hline S & - & 15 & 12 & - & - & - \\ A & - & - & - & 7 & 9 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 11 & - \\ C & - & - & - & - & - & 6 \\ D & - & - & - & - & - & 20 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

A flow network is recorded in this table.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & F & G & H & J & K \\ \hline F & - & - & - & 10 & - \\ G & - & - & - & - & - \\ H & - & 6 & - & 5 & - \\ J & - & 17 & - & - & - \\ K & 14 & - & 8 & - & - \end{array}$
Which vertex is the source and which is the sink?
Explain how the table shows this.
foundation.solution_text:
1. **Identify the source and the sink from the table**
Column $K$ contains only dashes, so nothing is directed into $K$.
Row $G$ contains only dashes, so nothing is directed out of $G$.
$K$ is the source and $G$ is the sink.

development.question_text:

$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & D & T \\ \hline S & - & 60 & 45 & - & - & - \\ A & - & - & 20 & 30 & - & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 50 & - \\ C & - & - & - & - & - & 35 \\ D & - & - & - & - & - & 55 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

development.solution_text:

development.question_text:
Parcels leave a warehouse $W$ and are delivered to a hub $Z$.
All routes are one-way, and the numbers are parcels per hour: $W$ to $P$ ($55$), $W$ to $Q$ ($40$), $P$ to $R$ ($30$), $P$ to $Q$ ($18$), $Q$ to $U$ ($48$), $R$ to $Z$ ($26$), and $U$ to $Z$ ($60$).
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

development.solution_text:
The table has six entries that are not dashes, so the network needs six edges, but only five are drawn.
The entry $8$ sits in row $A$, column $B$.
The edge from $A$ to $B$ with capacity $8$ is missing and must be drawn, with its arrow pointing from $A$ to $B$.

development.question_text:
A flow network is recorded in this table.
The rows are listed in alphabetical order, not in the order material travels.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & A & B & C & D & E \\ \hline A & - & - & - & - & - \\ B & 7 & - & - & - & 13 \\ C & - & 21 & - & 16 & - \\ D & - & - & - & - & 9 \\ E & 24 & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network, with the source at the left and the sink at the right.

development.solution_text:
Each edge is recorded once, in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters. Where the vertices are drawn on the page makes no difference to the table.

mastery.question_text:
An airline moves cargo from a hub $S$ to a destination $T$ through five sorting centres.
The table gives the greatest number of tonnes per day each one-way leg can carry.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & D & E & T \\ \hline S & - & 90 & 120 & - & - & - & - \\ A & - & - & - & 50 & 40 & - & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 70 & 60 & - \\ C & - & - & - & - & - & - & 55 \\ D & - & - & - & - & - & - & 100 \\ E & - & - & - & - & - & - & 45 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

mastery.solution_text:
Each edge is recorded once, in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccccc} \text{From / To} & N & P & Q & R & U & V & W \\ \hline N & - & 17 & 23 & - & - & - & - \\ P & - & - & - & 11 & 8 & - & - \\ Q & - & - & - & - & 14 & 19 & - \\ R & - & - & - & - & - & - & 10 \\ U & - & - & - & - & - & - & 26 \\ V & - & - & - & - & - & - & 15 \\ W & - & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
$N$ is the source, because column $N$ is entirely dashes, so no edge is directed into it. $W$ is the sink, because row $W$ is entirely dashes, so no edge is directed out of it.

mastery.question_text:
A gas company moves gas from a well $W$ to a plant $Z$.
Every pipe is one-way and the capacities are in terajoules per day.
Gas is pumped from $W$ to $A$ ($180$), from $W$ to $B$ ($150$), from $A$ to $C$ ($95$), from $A$ to $D$ ($70$), from $B$ to $D$ ($110$), from $B$ to $E$ ($60$), from $D$ back up to $C$ ($25$), from $C$ to $Z$ ($85$), from $D$ to $Z$ ($140$), and from $E$ to $Z$ ($55$).
Draw the weighted directed flow network.
